questions.content:
The following are profit-margin percentages and return-on-capital percentages for 35 retailers.

**Profit margins:**

```text
10.9 5.0 6.1 5.9 9.2 3.3 4.0 3.1 11.2 1.8 3.2 4.4
24.0 2.9 5.0 5.3 2.2 3.9 6.9 5.9 5.9 5.9 5.8 7.0
8.6 5.0 5.4 5.2 4.7 6.8 4.9 3.6 1.1 3.6 5.9
```

**Returns on capital:**

```text
25.7 17.0 14.7 11.6 22.8 21.7 20.6 8.3 20.3 0.0 11.2 18.3
13.1 19.2 19.7 12.8 9.2 15.9 19.8 11.5 14.7 14.4 12.7 12.6
25.1 15.4 11.0 20.8 15.2 8.6 33.4 16.5 4.0 17.6 21.1
```

a. Construct a stem-and-leaf display for profit margin, using the whole-number part as the stem and the tenths digit as the leaf. Describe its shape.

b. Construct the analogous display for return on capital and describe its shape.

c. Compare the two distributions.

d. Group the profit margins into the intervals $[1.05,4.95)$, $[4.95,8.85)$, $[8.85,12.75)$, $[12.75,16.65)$, $[16.65,20.55)$, and $[20.55,24.45)$; give the class frequencies.

The following waiting times, in minutes, were recorded for 100 randomly selected bank customers during peak hours.

```text
1.6 6.6 5.6 5.1 3.9 4.6 6.5 6.4 8.6 4.2 5.8 3.4 9.3
7.4 1.8 6.2 5.4 4.9 5.4 0.8 2.5 8.3 6.1 6.3

3.6 2.7 3.7 0.4 10.2 2.8 11.6 4.3 3.1 5.8 5.6
4.4 4.5 6.7 8.1 4.3 2.2 5.8 8.6 2.0 8.0 9.5
1.3 4.8 9.9 7.9 1.1 7.2 2.9 9.1 7.7 4.0 1.4
```
